title: Language-Dependent Political Bias in AI: A Study of ChatGPT and Gemini

bias_targets.methodology: Administering the 62-item Political Compass Test to ChatGPT and Gemini to determine their ideological positions on a two-dimensional grid measuring economic (left/right) and social (authoritarian/liberal) alignments.

Querying the models with the Political Compass Test across 14 different languages and analyzing the variations in political alignment responses using K-means clustering and Euclidean distance measurements to evaluate how language choice affects model output.
